theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.RHFinitePrefixFirewall.finite_prefix_has_distinct_antitone_nonnegative_extensions
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ),   ∃ f g,     (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ f n) ∧       (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ g n) ∧ Antitone f ∧ Antitone g ∧ (∀ n ≤ N, f n = g n) ∧ f (N + 1) = 0 ∧ g (N + 1) = 1
